title: Next says an external technology supplier had a cyber incident involving data linked to the company
summary: Sada Elbalad, citing MENA and The Guardian, reports that British retailer Next said in a statement to investors that an external technology supplier suffered a cyber incident leading to unauthorised access to data linked to the company. Next says its own systems were not breached and it believes customer personal data was not compromised. Investigations are continuing; Next says it is working with the supplier, law enforcement and regulators.
plain: Next says a technology supplier it uses had a cyber incident touching some Next-linked data, but that its own systems were not breached and it believes customers' personal data was not compromised.
exec: Next says a supplier's incident touched data linked to the company and that it believes customer personal data was not compromised.
action: Rapid7's Alan Simpson, quoted by the report, advises customers to be wary of unexpected emails, texts or calls and to use the official site or app rather than links.
